One peer cap, three pins: unblocking the demos dependency group

PR #4110, superseding GH-4098 (Validate Renderer failure, run 34806536050). Dependabot's npm-minor-patch group for orchestkit-demos bundled a react minor that no @react-three/fiber release accepts. This page records the measured resolution: what failed, why pinning was the only honest fix, and the two hidden traps the lockfile regen surfaced on the way.

The conflict, verbatim from the failed run

npm error While resolving: @react-three/fiber@9.7.0
npm error Found: react@19.3.0
npm error Could not resolve dependency:
npm error peer react@">=19 <19.3" from @react-three/fiber@9.7.0
npm error   @react-three/fiber@"^9.6.1" from the root project
npm error   peer @react-three/fiber@"^9.0.0" from @react-three/drei@10.7.8
npm error   1 more (@remotion/three)

Four packages in the tree peer on react, and only one of them caps it. npm view @react-three/fiber@latest returns 9.7.0: there is no newer release to bump to, so "bump the conflicting peer" is not on the table this week. The react bump itself is what must wait.

Interactive: flip the react version, watch the peers

The exact peer ranges read from the resolved tree, checked against each candidate react version. This is the whole ERESOLVE, reproduced.

Trap one: caret ranges let the remotion family drift apart

Regenerating the lockfile with the manifest's mixed caret ranges (^4.0.506 and ^4.0.523 on today's base) can re-resolve some remotion packages to 4.0.524 while others stay locked lower. Measured live on GH-4098's base, where the lock held 4.0.522: the demo unit tests failed with TypeError: Multiple versions of Remotion detected: 4.0.522 and 4.0.524 thrown from checkMultipleRemotionVersions, from a nested copy under @remotion/animation-utils/node_modules/remotion. Same guard, same shape, whatever the base version.

stateremotion versions in locknpm test
GH-4098's lock (main before #4097)4.0.522 onlypasses (install is what fails)
regenerated lock on that base, caret ranges (measured)4.0.522 + 4.0.524 (40 packages, split)1 suite fails to import
all remotion packages exact 4.0.523 (this PR)4.0.523 only293 passed

Exact pins make future remotion bumps arrive as one explicit, CI-validated group instead of in-range drift. Same lesson as #3086, one layer down.

Trap two: zod 4.6.2 splits zod in two

With the remotion family at 4.0.523, four packages pin zod exactly 4.5.4: @remotion/studio, @remotion/studio-server, @remotion/studio-protocol and @remotion/media (checked on the npm registry at 4.0.523; @remotion/zod-types@4.0.523 itself has no zod dependency). The group's zod bump installs cleanly and even passes tests, but the tree ends with root zod above 4.5.4 plus nested 4.5.4 copies, and npx remotion compositions prints a block warning of "React context and hooks not working, failed renders and unclear errors" (measured with the 4.6.2 bump on the 4.0.522 base; the split shape is the same at 4.0.523). Exit code 0, warning shipped, breakage deferred to a render. Pinned zod to 4.5.4: one copy, no warning.

.github/dependabot.yml got ignore entries for react, react-dom, and zod (minors and majors) in the demos stream, same pattern as the existing typescript ignore, so the next Monday cycle does not re-open this exact failure.

CI agreed: the Validate Renderer job on #4110 is green. Flagged but not fixed here: npm run lint in orchestkit-demos is broken on main already (eslint 10.10.0 requires ajv/lib/refs/json-schema-draft-04.json, which the repo's ajv: ^8 override removes). Main's lock has the identical eslint plus ajv resolution, so the failure predates this PR.
